The Chanakya — Christmas, designed.

Festive installation concepts for the atrium of The Chanakya, a luxury destination in New Delhi. A spiral of ornaments rising like a tree made of light; a single giant bauble suspended against the glass; a gold "X·MAS" ring; a herd of line-drawn reindeer mid-leap. Quiet, modern, expensive-feeling Christmas.

Festive installation design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·51.
